sentences.en: How much is the monthly fee of this swimming school?

sentences.en: I am given a monthly allowance of fifty thousand yen.

sentences.en: Her husband intends to bring out a new monthly magazine.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫打算推出一本新的月刊杂志。
